mcq.text: DUMMY QUESTION

fill_blank.text: The prime mover of a diesel-electric locomotive is the ______.
The device used to change the direction of current flow to traction motors for reversing locomotive direction is called the ______.
In a diesel-electric locomotive, the ______ governs fuel injection to maintain constant engine speed at a given notch.
Three-phase locomotives draw single-phase AC from the OHE and convert it using a ______ before feeding the traction motors.
The semiconductor devices commonly used in the converter/inverter of three-phase locomotives are ______.
In three-phase locomotives, wheel slip/slide control is achieved through ______ control of individual traction motors.
WAG12B is a ______ HP class electric freight locomotive.
WAG12B locomotives are manufactured at the Electric Locomotive Factory located at ______.
Before departure, the Loco Pilot must ensure the ______ certificate is available and valid.
As per rules, the speed of a train must never exceed the ______ prescribed for the section or the stock, whichever is lower.
In case of failure of the train's brake system causing an unscheduled stop, the Loco Pilot must protect the train as per ______ rule.
Kavach was developed by the Research Designs and Standards Organisation, commonly abbreviated as ______.
Kavach uses ______ technology for continuous train location and movement authority updates.
fill_blank.answer: RFID and GPS with radio communication

fill_blank.text: In Kavach-fitted sections, the system enforces automatic brake application to prevent ______ collisions and SPAD incidents.
DPWCS enables synchronised throttle, braking, and fault status communication between the lead and remote locomotives in a ______ formation.
The ______ generator supplies power for battery charging and control circuits in a diesel-electric locomotive.
The ______ steps down OHE voltage before it is fed to the converter-inverter system in a three-phase locomotive.
WAG12B locomotives operate on ______ kV AC single-phase electrification.
A Loco Pilot must always carry a valid ______ and identity card while on duty.
The onboard Kavach unit displays speed and signal information to the Loco Pilot on the ______.
DPWCS communication between the lead and remote locomotives is carried over a ______ link.
In a diesel-electric locomotive, the ______ uses exhaust gas energy to boost intake air pressure.
______-based converters offer lower switching losses compared to older GTO-based converters in three-phase locomotives.
In addition to air brakes, WAG12B locomotives are equipped with ______ braking to recover energy.
Signal sighting distance is governed by the General Rules and the ______ Manual.
Kavach's high safety reliability is certified through a ______ (Safety Integrity Level) rating.
If the wireless link in a DPWCS-fitted train fails, the Loco Pilot is alerted and may need to take ______ action.
The ______ test checks diesel engine and alternator performance under simulated load conditions.
Notching up too quickly under low adhesion conditions can cause wheel ______ in three-phase locomotives.
WAG12B's higher haulage capacity compared to WAG9 is mainly due to its higher ______ and improved traction control.
At a level crossing, the Loco Pilot must sound the whistle as prescribed and be prepared to ______.
Kavach's radio communication operates in the ______ band as specified by RDSO.
DPWCS reduces in-train (buff and draft) forces by synchronising ______ and traction across the consist.
The ______ reservoir maintains the reference pressure for automatic air brake application.
A ______ is not part of a three-phase locomotive's traction system (it belongs to older carburetted engines instead).
WAG12B locomotives are primarily deployed on high-speed heavy haul freight corridors under Mission ______.
Consumption of ______ before or during duty by running staff is strictly prohibited.
One of Kavach's key objectives is preventing accidents caused by Signal Passed at Danger, commonly abbreviated ______.
DPWCS allows a single Loco Pilot at the lead locomotive to control traction and braking of ______ locomotives.
The ______ gauge indicates the engine's lubricating oil pressure on a diesel-electric locomotive.
Fault diagnostics in modern three-phase locomotives are aided by ______-based control and display systems.
The ______ on a WAG12B locomotive collects current from the overhead equipment.
In foggy weather, Loco Pilots must additionally rely on ______ and reduced speed as prescribed.
Kavach mandates fitment of ______ tags along the track for accurate train location identification.
DPWCS synchronisation helps prevent excessive buff and draft ______ between locomotive groups in a distributed power train.

descriptive.text: Explain briefly the function of the traction alternator in a diesel-electric locomotive.
Describe the sequence of the starting procedure of a diesel-electric locomotive before departure.
Explain the working of the wheel slip control system in a conventional diesel-electric locomotive and its importance.
List the main advantages of three-phase locomotives over conventional DC traction motor locomotives.
Explain the working principle of regenerative braking in three-phase locomotives.
Describe the role of the converter and inverter in a three-phase locomotive traction system.
Describe the salient technical features and operational role of the WAG12B locomotive in Indian Railways.
Explain the duties of a Loco Pilot before starting a locomotive from the shed.
Explain the procedure to be followed by a Loco Pilot in the event of Signal Passed at Danger (SPAD).
Explain the objectives and basic working principle of the Kavach train collision avoidance system.
List the key technical specifications of the WAG12B locomotive (horsepower, traction type, and typical usage).
Explain the precautions a Loco Pilot must take while running a train in foggy or low-visibility conditions.
Explain how DPWCS helps synchronise distributed power locomotives in a long freight train and the benefits of this synchronisation.
Explain the function and importance of the turbocharger in a diesel-electric locomotive.
Explain the basic difference between a conventional DC traction motor locomotive and a three-phase induction motor locomotive.
Explain the role of RFID tags and onboard Kavach equipment in preventing Signal Passed at Danger (SPAD) incidents.
Describe the precautions to be taken by a Loco Pilot while approaching an unmanned level crossing.
Compare the WAG12B locomotive with the WAG9 locomotive in terms of horsepower, haulage capacity and typical deployment.
Explain the purpose of the equalizing reservoir in the automatic air brake system of a locomotive.
Explain how microprocessor-based fault diagnostics assist a Loco Pilot in operating a three-phase locomotive.
